question: Which type of air purifier uses oil to absorb heavy dust particles?
solution:
The correct answer is __Wet-type.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Wet-type air purifiers__ use oil or water to trap and absorb heavy dust particles.
 
• These purifiers are designed to capture fine dust and pollutants from the air effectively.
 
• They are especially useful in industrial settings where the air is heavily polluted with dust and debris.
 
• Oil or water serves as a medium to bind the dust particles, preventing them from reentering the air.
 
• Wet-type air purifiers require regular maintenance to ensure optimal performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cyclonic-type Air Purifiers:**

 
 
• These purifiers use a cyclonic effect to separate dust particles from the air.
 
• They are commonly used in vacuum cleaners and industrial air cleaning systems.
 
 
 
• **Electronic-type Air Purifiers:**
 
 
• Electronic air purifiers use electric charges to capture dust particles.
 
• They employ technologies such as ionizers or electrostatic precipitators.
 
 
 
• **Dry-type Air Purifiers:**
 
 
• These purifiers use filters, such as HEPA filters, to trap dust particles.
 
• They do not use any liquid medium for air purification.
